artifact: Key ring journal entry, the materialized ring view and the ring binding payload; the binding is a COSE_Sign1 of the profile in crates/permguard-objects/src/cose.rs by the Host identity key, content type permguard.host.ring-binding.v1, its kid the identity epoch in decimal ASCII
authority: 1-architecture/4-architecture-server-host-keys.md#lifecycle and #files-on-disk, 1-architecture/2-architecture-server-host-identity.md (ring binding members), owner decisions of 2026-10-08 (labels, types, cardinalities); crates/permguard-host/src/keys/record.rs
encoding: deterministic CBOR (RFC 8949 core deterministic), integers in the signed 64-bit range

fields.name: seq
fields.note: from 1, one more than the entry before it

fields.name: kind
fields.note: prepublished, activated, retired, revoked, archived, destroyed or bound

fields.name: kid
fields.note: <ring>:<thumbprint>; on bound, the host.identity kid of the key that signed the binding

fields.name: epoch
fields.note: the ring epoch once the entry applies: one more on prepublished, archived and a revocation out of the published set

fields.name: at
fields.note: seconds since the epoch, UTC

fields.name: operation_id
fields.note: 16 bytes: the security mutation of an operator's rotation or revocation

fields.name: reason
fields.note: on revoked only, and required there: 1 to 256 bytes

fields.name: jwk
fields.note: on prepublished only, and required there: the RFC 7517 JSON of the public key as published

fields.name: compromised_at
fields.note: on revoked only: when the key is known or believed compromised

fields.name: ring
fields.note: host.operations, control.attest or data.attest

fields.name: suite
fields.note: pg-ed25519-sha256-v1 or pg-p256-sha256-v1

fields.name: key_set_digest
fields.note: 32 bytes, the digest key-set.json registers the input of

fields.name: keys
fields.note: every key the ring ever held, in the order it was prepublished

fields.name: state
fields.note: prepublished, active, retired-public, revoked or archived

fields.name: jwk
fields.note: the RFC 7517 JSON of the public key as published

fields.name: host_id
fields.note: exactly 16 bytes

fields.name: key_set_digest
fields.note: 32 bytes

fields.name: suite
fields.note: the ring's suite

fields.name: not_before
fields.note: seconds since the epoch, UTC

fields.name: not_after
fields.note: not_before + 30 days; after not_before
